{{Top|leg}}
The '''isk-ar''' were one of the subspecies of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were albinos, with translucent [[Color/Legends|white]] scales and no other distinguishing marks.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' gives the ''isk-ar'' race the Gearhead feat, suggesting there may be biological or cultural factors positively impacting the race's ability to understand machines and computers.
